notes: REAL LIVE CONTRACT IS NOT CLEAN, despite this being the capability CI used to prove the contract gate catches a synthetic phantom field (phantom_field_from_a_half_fix). That synthetic test only proves the gate flags an ADDED fake field; it says nothing about the genuine baseline, which independently has real drift: a top-level field (skipped_test_case_ids) the tool description explicitly promises is missing on every success response, two declared testrun fields (type, self_ui_link) never render, and eight undeclared fields (attachments, created_by, updated_by, closed_at, closed_by, issues, test_result_issues, observability_id) are returned but never declared. VERIFIED IT ACTUALLY STUCK: read back via two independent readers post-write - get_test_run_by_integer_id_v1 (single-run read, declares only id/identifier/name/uuid but actually also returns the full detail incl. owner=3741/assignee.id=3741) and get_test_runs_v1 (list read, the one with the known 15-17/30 null-owner list-serializer bug). BOTH readers show owner=3741 and assignee={id:3741,...} for TR-9110, not null. This distinguishes the two candidate explanations the task raised: a newly-assigned owner reading back null would mean either 'write silently failed' or 'list serializer drops the field' - here it read back POPULATED on both readers, so this write neither failed nor got swallowed by the list-serializer null bug; the bug only affects rows this probe did not touch (confirmed separately in setup.step 2's baseline: TR-9110 itself, and TR-9062/TR-9061, were among the null rows BEFORE this write). ID FORM: no trap found - both "TR-9110" and bare integer "17577900" work, matching the declared path pattern exactly (contrast with get_test_run_by_integer_id_v1 which hard-requires the integer, and list_test_runs_v2 which carries no integer id at all). USER ID FORM: TM user id (not browserstack_user_id, not email) - confirmed via get_group_users_v2_v1 round-trip. WRAPPER TRAP: guidance was accurate in this direction - flat body is genuinely correct, no nested test_run wrapper needed; only one of the two guidance directions the task warned about (flat vs nested) was even in play for this capability, and it held up. ENTITLEMENT GATES: not encountered - both writes returned clean 200 {success:true}, no 200-with-success:false seen. ERROR ENVELOPE: not independently verified against live responses - both attempts succeeded on the first try, so no 4xx/5xx body was observed to compare against the declared (3-of-11-correct) error shapes; this remains unverified by this probe rather than confirmed either way. Target run TR-9110 (project PR-2005/379335744) is now left with owner=3741 (User C) as a side effect of this probe - TR-9075, TR-9061 and TR-9062 were never touched.
